# ppds_forms_get

Inspect a form by ID. Use unpublished=true to inspect its draft and obtain the fingerprint required before editing or publishing.

## Input schema

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| entityLogicalName | `String` | yes | Table logical name |
| formId | `Guid` | yes | Stable form ID |
| unpublished | `Boolean` | no | Read unpublished draft instead of published form |

## Output

Returns `Task<FormGetResult>`.
